next.reason: 1985: "only in a SEARCH or SET statement, a relation condition, the USING phrase of a Procedure Division header, or the USING phrase of a CALL"; 2023: "an intrinsic function argument, an inline method invocation argument, ... or the USING phrase of a CALL or INVOKE statement". 2023 also allows an index data item as an intrinsic function argument, which the 1985 rule forbids; inline method invocation and INVOKE are new contexts.
